shapes.design_purpose: The only prototype shape so far. Two units per block equals one harvest swing, so a small shelter visibly eats into a resource node instead of feeling free.

design_purpose: grid_size_metres balances Minecraft-like constraint against detail (final value is an open question in construction.md). placement_range_metres is measured from the third-person camera, which sits about 4.5 m behind the player, so it must cover that set-back plus reach; 6 m could not reach the floor in front of the player. removal_refund_fraction controls experimentation freedom versus commitment and deliberately mirrors salvage_return_fraction in crafting.json so building and crafting feel like one economy.
